primary_heading: От бр. В. Новикова. Уфим. губ.
persons_places: дер. Н., Стерлитамакский уезд, Уфимская губерния; Иван/И. Г. Плесачев; П. И. Парев; С. С. Бондаренко
content_summary: Primary page confirms a mob attack during a prayer meeting on 2 September attended by more than 20 people. The crowd broke windows and beat worshippers; Ivan Plesachev was knocked down and kicked, P. I. Parev was struck in the chest and lay unconscious, and householder S. S. Bondarenko was beaten. After recovering, I. G. Plesachev read the Gospel while the women sang. Seven people were baptized on 9 September; the report states 25 had joined the church between 20 May and 9 September 1907.
transcription_guard: Village designation is abbreviated in print; do not expand it. The Ivan/I. G. initials should be treated as printed variants until identity reconciliation.
